committee: *Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 352-38 (COR) - Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 352-38 (COR), recognizing the Mayor of Piti, Honorable Jesse Alig and the Piti Municipal Planning Council (MPC) Members for their efforts in organizing and hosting the first-ever Piti Sea Festival. The presentation is scheduled for Saturday, May 30, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at Pedro Santos Park in Piti. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary, Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane, at 671-989-2572 or via email at office.senatorbri@ guamlegislature.gov . 5/26/26 1:42 p.m. (FN)
